description: This Dart source file defines the HomeController class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier responsible for managing the state and data fetching logic for the home screen in a Flutter app. It interacts with a ContentRepository to load home feed data, handle cache invalidation, and manage continue watching items.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the loading and state of the home feed and continue watching list, utilizing a repository for data fetching and cache management.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed data asynchronously, updates state accordingly, and triggers loading of continue watching items unless disabled in test config.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads the list of recently watched content items with their progress, managing loading state and handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the continue watching list after playback progress is saved, ensuring UI reflects latest data.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Re-fetches home feed and continue watching data to keep UI synchronized with cache updates.
